## T4 — the audit door: EV of one 13k producer's full campaign through ONE colluding 130k covering seat, MSK

K = the bond's outstanding cap N_out(rho) issued before its first conviction freezes it (AG-3). Each attempt licenses with P* = 1/2 (the colluding seat); each licensed fraud is refused by its audit unless the auditor passes it (probability beta: a compromised or careless auditor host — beta = 0 under the operator stopgap). A refused licensed fraud is convicted: the seat's S4 while its collateral lasts (13 charges) and the producer's tier while its free half lasts (5); an unlicensed attempt loses m_c + w; a passed fraud gains E at maturity.

With k_aud = 2 (two distinct pool members must each sign a receipt; v3 requires it from rho 250) a fraud passes only if both pass it: beta_eff = beta^2 for independent hosts. 'x10 producers' is ten Sybil 13k producers (K = 10 N_out) sharing the one colluding seat's 13 charges.

| 10 | 1 | 1 | 20 | -105,727 | -104,447 | -100,606 | -98,301 | 796 permille |
| 100 | 1 | 1 | 200 | -134,545 | -131,344 | -121,741 | -115,980 | 421 permille |
| 250 | 1 | 1 | 500 | -134,561 | -126,559 | -102,552 | -88,148 | 169 permille |
| 250 | 1 | 2 | 500 | -134,561 | -134,481 | -133,280 | -131,869 | 411 permille |
| 1000 | 1 | 1 | 2,000 | -134,641 | -102,633 | -6,608 | +51,008 | 43 permille |
| 1000 | 1 | 2 | 2,000 | -134,641 | -134,321 | -129,520 | -123,874 | 206 permille |

beta = 0 (every licensed fraud refused): no fraud is ever paid; EV = -(what the refusals collect) - K(1-P*)(m + w).

## T11 — what one deliberate trip of the network breaker costs, MSK (what the code actually collects)

v2's K1 (escaped value) as the review recomputed it: a conviction after maturity finds no vesting row (post_final_producer_leg_v1: 'Otherwise nothing: no row') and no live lock, so the K1 event itself costs 0; the cost is the pre-maturity detections needed to get an escape, (q/(1-q))(S4 + m_c) each, less the escaped E - m_c:
* rho 10, q 0.5: 7,041.86 per escape, three escapes 21,125.59 (v2 claimed 57,910.16)
* rho 1000, q 0.5: 6,408.09 per escape, three escapes 19,224.28 (v2 claimed 57,910.16)
* v2's K1 is also near-unreachable: retirement is max(Final + 3,000, the last session's close + 1) and maturity is Final + 3,000 or later, so a conviction lands after maturity only in a session that outlives it — v3 drops K1.
* v3 K1' (a conviction of a credited claim that carries an audit receipt): needs an operator auditor to sign a false receipt — an outsider cannot force it.
* v3 K2 (slash shortfall, >= 3 DISTINCT bonds short, forfeited bonds excluded): >= 3 x 13,000 = 39,000 MSK of producer collateral drained by the griefer's own tier convictions.
* v3 K6 (audit service): operator auditors late on > 5% of the epoch's credited licences — forced only by taking the operator's hosts down, which is the event it exists to report (the claims wait; nothing is paid unaudited).
* K3 / K4: unattributable residual only; a griefer's own seats above 20% silence enter the non-service list and stop counting (qualitative, as v2).
